rule: WAITING is line-specific and never means mission IDLE or DONE. If one item is blocked, executable non-blocked work remains active.

items.description: Complete repository-backed zero-context legacy reconstruction and expose all critical missing state as explicit gaps.
items.scientific_reason: Scientific continuity depends on preserving epistemic status, limitations, validation boundaries and rationale across agent instances.
items.technical_reason: A future instance must reconstruct actionable state without conversation history.
items.expected_artifact: mission/MISSION_MASTER_STATE.json plus mission registry, bootstrap contract, audit and queue updates
items.verification_method: Repository-only reconstruction test + bootstrap validator + Git/PR/CI reconciliation

items.description: Inspect warning, decision and action consumers and existing persistence before designing or adding response-coupling ledger functionality.
items.scientific_reason: Operational effectiveness cannot be evaluated without linking warning, decision, response exposure and outcome ascertainment.
items.technical_reason: Avoid duplicate state and preserve existing producer/consumer contracts.
prerequisites: Legacy reconstruction sufficient to identify relevant surfaces
items.expected_artifact: Response-coupling audit and, only if justified, response ledger implementation/tests
items.verification_method: Source inspection + contract audit + ordinary and adversarial tests + scientific consistency audit
items.handoff_target: NEXO/FORJA only if a distinct mathematical or interaction-model gap is demonstrated

when_blocked: Register blocker and exact blocking dependency.
Continue the highest-priority non-blocked queue item.
Reassess dependency during every bootstrap/reconciliation cycle.
Resume blocked item automatically when dependency is resolved.
